```{r}
# custom functions for later (flatten the cluster covariance matrices)
coef.multinom_flat <- function(object, ...) {
  B <- NextMethod()
  v <- as.vector(t(B))
  names(v) <- paste(rep(rownames(B), each = ncol(B)),
                    rep(colnames(B), times = nrow(B)), sep = ':')
  v
}

vcov.multinom_flat <- function(object, ...) attr(object, 'V_cl')
```

```{r}
build_variance_components <- function(df, station_vars){#, region_time_vars) {

  # WITHIN RT (region-month-year)
  df <- df %>%
    group_by(Region, region_time) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of(station_vars),
        list(
          rt_mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),   # region-time mean (Xbar_rt)
          within_rt = ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) # dev per station (d_srt)
        ),
        .names = '{.col}_{.fn}'
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # BETWEEN REGION (regional mean)
  rt_mean_vars <- paste0(station_vars, '_rt_mean')

  region_means <- df %>%
    distinct(
      Region,
      region_time,
      across(all_of(rt_mean_vars))
    ) %>%
    group_by(Region) %>%
    summarize(
      across(
        all_of(rt_mean_vars),
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),  # regional mean (Xbar_r)
        .names = '{.col}_bw_region'
      ),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ sub('_rt_mean_bw_region$', '_bw_region', .x)
    )

  df <- df %>%
    left_join(region_means, by = 'Region')

  # OVER RT (d_rt = Xbar_rt - Xbar_r)
  for (v in station_vars) {
    df[[paste0(v, '_over_rt')]] <-
      df[[paste0(v, '_rt_mean')]] -
      df[[paste0(v, '_bw_region')]]
  }

  # REGION-TIME VARS (already at rt level; no within-rt, has over_rt/bw_region)
  # region_time_bw <- df %>%
  #   distinct(Region, region_time, across(all_of(region_time_vars))) %>%
  #   group_by(Region) %>%
  #   summarize(
  #     across(
  #       all_of(region_time_vars),
  #       ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
  #       .names = '{.col}_bw_region'
  #     ),
  #     .groups = 'drop'
  #   )
  # 
  # df <- df %>%
  #   left_join(region_time_bw, by = 'Region')
  # 
  # for (v in region_time_vars) {
  #   df[[paste0(v, '_over_rt')]] <-
  #     df[[v]] - df[[paste0(v, '_bw_region')]]
  # }

  df
}
```

# Bloom vs No Bloom

```{r}
# VARIABLES

station_vars <- c(
  'Temperature',
  'log_DIN_lag',
  'frac_NH4_lag',
  'log_DissAmmonia_lag',
  'log_DissNitrateNitrite_lag',
  'log_DissSilica_lag',
  'log_DissOrthophos_lag',
  'log_Turbidity_lag',
  'log_Conductivity'
)

# region_time_vars <- c(
#   'log_graze_rate'
# )

delta_time_vars <- c(
  'log_SAC',
  'log_SJR',
  'log_EXPORTS',
  'log_OUT',
  'log_SAC_lag',
  'log_SJR_lag',
  'log_EXPORTS_lag',
  'log_OUT_lag'
)

# DATA

# No Bloom: 0; Bloom (HAB/BAB): 1
df_bloom <- df_mvi %>%
  mutate(
    Bloom = as.integer(mvi_class %in% c('HAB', 'BAB'))
  )

df_wsjr <- build_variance_components(df_bloom, station_vars)#, region_time_vars)
```

```{r}
# calc weighted (due to repeated stations) variance
wvar <- function(x, w) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w)
  x <- x[keep]
  w <- w[keep]
  mu <- weighted.mean(x, w)
  weighted.mean((x - mu)^2, w)
}

calc_variance_decomp <- function(v, df) {
  within_col <- paste0(v, '_within_rt')
  over_col <- paste0(v, '_over_rt')
  bw_col <- paste0(v, '_bw_region')
  
  has_within <- within_col %in% names(df)
  required_cols <- c(v, over_col, bw_col, if (has_within) within_col)
  
  tmp <- df %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(required_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    group_by(Region, region_time) %>%
    mutate(wt = 1 / n()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  total_var <- wvar(tmp[[v]], tmp$wt)
  var_over <- wvar(tmp[[over_col]], tmp$wt)
  var_between <- wvar(tmp[[bw_col]], tmp$wt)
  var_within <- if (has_within) wvar(tmp[[within_col]], tmp$wt) else 0
  
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    perc_within_rt = if (has_within) (var_within / total_var) * 100 else NA,
    perc_over_rt = (var_over / total_var) * 100,
    perc_bw_region = (var_between / total_var) * 100,
    perc_sum = ((var_within + var_over + var_between) / total_var) * 100
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
}

variance_check <- lapply(c(station_vars), calc_variance_decomp, df = df_wsjr) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

# variance_check <- lapply(c(station_vars, region_time_vars), calc_variance_decomp, df = df_wsjr) %>%
#   dplyr::bind_rows()

variance_check
```

```{r}
m_bloom_af <- glm(
  Bloom ~
    Temperature_over_rt +
    
    log_Turbidity_lag_within_rt + log_Turbidity_lag_over_rt +
    
    log_Conductivity_over_rt + log_Conductivity_bw_region +
    
    log_SAC + log_SJR + log_EXPORTS +
    
    log_SAC_lag3 + log_SJR_lag3 + log_EXPORTS_lag3 +
    
    log_DIN_lag_within_rt + log_DIN_lag_over_rt +
    
    frac_NH4_lag_within_rt + frac_NH4_lag_over_rt +
    
    log_DissOrthophos_lag_within_rt + log_DissOrthophos_lag_over_rt,
  
  data = df_wsjr,
  family = binomial
)

summary(m_bloom_af)
```

```{r}

  cluster = ~ region_time + Date,
  cadjust = TRUE
)

  vcov. = V_rt_date
)
```

```{r}
library(lmtest)

V <- vcovCL(m_mn, cluster = ~ region_time + Date, cadjust = TRUE)

cf_mat <- coef(m_mn)

cf_flat <- setNames(
  as.vector(t(cf_mat)),
  paste(rep(rownames(cf_mat), each = ncol(cf_mat)), colnames(cf_mat), sep = ':')
)

all(names(cf_flat) %in% colnames(V))   # confirm this is TRUE before trusting anything below

cf_flat <- cf_flat[colnames(V)]

se <- sqrt(diag(V))
z  <- cf_flat / se
p  <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))

results <- data.frame(term = names(cf_flat), estimate = cf_flat, robust_se = se, z = z, p = p, row.names = NULL)
results
```
```{r}
hab_names <- grep('^HAB:', names(cf_flat), value = TRUE)
vars      <- sub('^HAB:', '', hab_names)
bab_names <- paste0('BAB:', vars)

diff <- cf_flat[hab_names] - cf_flat[bab_names]

var_diff <- diag(V[hab_names, hab_names]) +
  diag(V[bab_names, bab_names]) -
  2 * diag(V[hab_names, bab_names])

se_diff <- sqrt(var_diff)
z <- diff / se_diff
p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))

hab_vs_bab <- data.frame(term = vars, estimate = diff, se = se_diff, z = z, p = p, row.names = NULL)
hab_vs_bab
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    HAB = as.integer(mvi_class == 'BAB')
  )

df_wsjr <- build_variance_components(df_bloom, station_vars)#, region_time_vars)
```

```{r}
# calc weighted (due to repeated stations) variance
wvar <- function(x, w) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w)
  x <- x[keep]
  w <- w[keep]
  mu <- weighted.mean(x, w)
  weighted.mean((x - mu)^2, w)
}

calc_variance_decomp <- function(v, df) {
  within_col <- paste0(v, '_within_rt')
  over_col <- paste0(v, '_over_rt')
  bw_col <- paste0(v, '_bw_region')
  
  has_within <- within_col %in% names(df)
  required_cols <- c(v, over_col, bw_col, if (has_within) within_col)
  
  tmp <- df %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(required_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    group_by(Region, region_time) %>%
    mutate(wt = 1 / n()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  total_var <- wvar(tmp[[v]], tmp$wt)
  var_over <- wvar(tmp[[over_col]], tmp$wt)
  var_between <- wvar(tmp[[bw_col]], tmp$wt)
  var_within <- if (has_within) wvar(tmp[[within_col]], tmp$wt) else 0
  
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    perc_within_rt = if (has_within) (var_within / total_var) * 100 else NA,
    perc_over_rt = (var_over / total_var) * 100,
    perc_bw_region = (var_between / total_var) * 100,
    perc_sum = ((var_within + var_over + var_between) / total_var) * 100
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
}

variance_check <- lapply(c(station_vars), calc_variance_decomp, df = df_wsjr) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

# variance_check <- lapply(c(station_vars, region_time_vars), calc_variance_decomp, df = df_wsjr) %>%
#   dplyr::bind_rows()

variance_check
```
